STEPHANIE J. RENNIE JUAN F. MARTINEZ
SHERIFF UNDERSHERIFF
Training Requirements
New Applicants (Resident Permit)
• Must complete a minimum 16-hour firearms training course.
Renewal Applicants
• Must complete a minimum 8-hour firearms training course.
Qualification & Certification
• Written verification is required from an Inyo County Sheriff’s Office-approved, certified firearms instructor
confirming the applicant can safely handle and fire each firearm listed on the application.
• Training certification must be dated within six months of the good cause notification (either before or after).
• The Sheriff reserves the right to deny a license for any firearm that has been altered from the manufacturer's
specifications or is deemed unsafe.
Permit Validity
• A CCW permit issued by the Inyo County Sheriff’s Office is valid for two years from the date of issuance.
Out-of-State Applicants
Applicants residing outside of California must still complete California-approved online training. CCW qualifications
or permits issued by other states do not meet California requirements and will not be accepted.
Training Process (Two-Part)
1. Online Education Course
• Must be completed through an approved Inyo County Sheriff’s Office online provider.
2. Live-Fire Qualification
• You must qualify with each handgun you intend to carry. (Up to three firearms are allowed on a permit)
• Handguns must be listed on your application by make, model, and serial number.
• A livefire course must be completed to for California Penal Code You must inform the agency of the course provider
beforehand. The live fire course selected must satisfy requirements 26165, and they shall either approve or suggest a
different course within 75 miles of your residence.

--- page break ---

Important Notes for Out-of-State Applicants
• Penal Codes 26150(a)(5), 26155(a)(5), and 26162 do not apply to nonresident applicants.
• Handguns must be legal to carry in California, although they do not need to be on the California Handgun
Roster.
Prohibited Items Include:
• Magazines exceeding 10 rounds
• Pistols with threaded barrels
• Handguns with laser attachments or uncommon calibers (subject to agency restrictions)
Check with your issuing agency for any specific restrictions on firearm types, accessories, or calibers.

www.sttarr.net
Trainer providing in-person instruction:

(760) 375-1004
www.GUNS4US.com
Eric Spoonhunter
(760) 937-2729
espoonhunter@mac.com
The Inyo County Sheriff’s Office is not accepting new training providers at this time.
For any questions regarding a CCW permit, contact the Inyo County Sheriff’s Office at, ccw@inyocounty.us or 760-
878-0336.
